scope: Native PC filesystem, ZIP CRC/SHA256 and controlled failure injection

results.test: Lossless backup/verify/restore includes UTF8 draft and partial files without modifying source
Rotation keeps newest terminal groups and every pending request and ID marker
Cancelled requests and late unused RSP are archived losslessly
Acknowledged remote error can be rotated
Invalid metadata refuses rotation but allows forensic backup
Conflicting cancellation and receipt are rejected
Published request without its reservation is rejected
Existing backup is never overwritten or used to authorize removal
Restore refuses nonempty directories and preserves existing files
Archive path traversal refused before any extraction
Changed data with valid ZIP CRC still fails SHA256 verification
Keep zero never removes pending requests
Interrupted rotation removes REQ first and leaves a verified recoverable backup
